_comment: ScatterID Production Configuration File. Treat this file as highly sensitive. Mount to all containers.

env.purpose: Governs log verbosity, TLS enforcing rules, and sandbox fallback modes.

crypto_service_url.purpose: Internal secure HTTPS URL of the crystal-dilithium microservice.

crypto_service_api_key.purpose: Bearer token securing crypto-service sign, pack, and rotate endpoints.

vault_token.purpose: Master token used initially to configure Vault authentication roles.

vault_role_id.purpose: Dynamic or static AppRole ID used by crypto-service to authenticate.

vault_secret_id.purpose: Dynamic or static AppRole Secret ID used by crypto-service to authenticate.

vault_secret_path.purpose: Vault KV v2 secrets path namespace for key rotation.

algorithm.purpose: Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature standard (NIST FIPS 204 CRYSTALS-Dilithium).

channel_name.purpose: Hyperledger Fabric channel ID where smart contract is committed.

chaincode_name.purpose: Go chaincode namespace on Fabric network.

peer_endpoint.purpose: Fabric Issuer peer gRPC connection endpoint.

peer_host_alias.purpose: SSL Hostname override certificate alias for the Fabric peer connection.
